parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The name of the device that receives the request.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: RequestBase64Byte
parameters.description: The string that is obtained by performing Base64 encoding on the message. Example: `dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period of a response. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 8000.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description:
The custom revert-RPC (RRPC) topic. Before you can use a custom RRPC topic, you must configure the device. For more information, see [Use custom topics](~~90570~~).

If you do not configure this parameter, the default RRPC topic is used.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot rrpc --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key aldfeSe0000 --device-name device1 --timeout 1000 --content-type 240 --request-base64-byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --topic /a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot RRpc --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ContentType 240 --Timeout 1000 --Topic '/a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update' --ProductKey aldfeSe0000 --RequestBase64Byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --DeviceName device1
